title: OKRs
equation: Aligned Output = Objective Clarity × KR Measurability × Public Commitment
hook: If your team can't say what winning looks like this quarter, you don't have goals. You have vibes.
statement: Line everyone up behind a few bold objectives, each with clear, measurable key results.
explainer: Objectives say where you're going. Key results are the numbers that prove you got there. Don't tie them to bonuses, though. People stop stretching the minute money's on the line.
sop: Give each one 3 or 4 key results with real numbers.
Make them visible to the whole team.
Score them weekly as red, yellow, or green.
Reset each quarter and learn from the misses.
equation_example: Score each 1 to 10. Objective Clarity 8, KR Measurability 7, Public Commitment 6. 8 × 7 × 6 = 336 out of 1,000. Higher means everyone can explain what winning looks like. Lower means the goals live on a slide, not in anyone's week.
question: Write 3 objectives for this quarter, each with one number that proves you hit it.
closing_statement: A goal without a number is just a wish.
caption:
Principle Nº 284: OKRs

If your team can't say what winning looks like this quarter, you don't have goals. You have vibes.

Line everyone up behind a few bold objectives, each with clear, measurable key results.
